context:
Goal: a session on Windows wakes when its background command ends, as it does in the cloud.
Problem (risk): nobody knows whether Claude Code on Windows wakes a session when a background command finishes, and sessions there rely on it.
Based on (read): you offered to test it at 15:50 CST; nothing waits on it.
Departs from: main — adds nothing; the answer is recorded for Windows sessions.
Why yours: no computer of yours is connected to any session (measured 2026-11-12 15:50 CST, the folder list was empty).

options.gain: Windows sessions can rely on the wake.
options.how: Paste into Claude Code on Windows: "Run `sleep 5; echo done` with run_in_background true. Then end your turn at once and say nothing more. When the command's exit wakes you, reply only: WOKE." If it replies WOKE by itself, pick this.
options.label: It woke

options.gain: Windows sessions get a check-in instead.
options.how: Same paste; pick this if it stays silent until you type.
options.label: It did not wake

ref: retrospective 15:51 CST Nov 12 (you offered in chat at 15:50 CST)
title: Optional: check that a finished background command wakes Claude Code on Windows
why: It needs Claude Code on your Windows machine.
